verdict.rationale: Meilisearch's docs describe typo tolerance as built in, letting users find results even with misspellings like 'phnoe' for 'phone', and its product page says this needs no tuning. Developers can configure it per index, override word-length thresholds via minWordSizeForTypos, and reorder the built-in 'typo' ranking rule. Missing for 10: detailed evidence of other fuzzy-matching controls (e.g., disabling typos on specific attributes or words, max typo counts), and independent or hands-on corroboration of typo-tolerance behavior.
